AuthorDetails.Name: Kevin Jump
AuthorDetails.Description: Creator of uSync, and founder of Jumoo, an Umbraco specialist development studio.

Description: uSync serializers and handlers for Umbraco Commerce. Extends uSync so store settings — stores, currencies, countries, regions, tax classes, shipping/payment methods, order statuses, and email/print/export templates — export and import as config files, the same way uSync handles content types and the rest of the backoffice. Discounts and gift cards are supported too, opt-in.

RelatedPackages.Description: The eCommerce solution by Umbraco HQ that this package brings uSync support to.
The base uSync package this bridges into Umbraco Commerce.
